title: Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. II 8-K Filing
summary: Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp. II (MLAC II), a Nasdaq-listed SPAC, announced on April 9, 2026 a non-binding letter of intent to potentially combine with Terra Quantum AG, a quantum technology company. The transaction remains subject to negotiation of definitive agreements, due diligence, and regulatory approvals. No assurance was given that the transaction would be consummated.
